headline.zh: 临街落地窗小馆，自然光充足
headline.en: Bright, street-facing café with floor-to-ceiling windows

traits.zh: 整面临街玻璃窗，自然光充足
traits.en: Floor-to-ceiling street-facing windows provide abundant natural light

traits.zh: 店内空间较小，为小型咖啡馆布局
traits.en: Compact layout typical of a small café

traits.zh: 店内有少量桌椅座位，约2-4个
吧台后方可见磨豆机等专业器具
traits.en: Professional equipment including a coffee grinder visible behind the counter

focus.zh: 空间小、座位少，专注办公受限
focus.en: Compact space and limited seating constrain focused work

linger.zh: 仅2–4个座位，久坐空间有限

adventure.zh: 配备专业磨豆机，饮品制作基础扎实
adventure.en: Professional grinder indicates solid brewing foundation
